prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. One square ESL vocabulary flashcard for pupils aged about ten in China. Friendly premium textbook cartoon, thick smooth dark-brown outlines, simple clean warm flat colors with gentle shading, pure white background, large shapes, very little clutter, readable at 80 pixels. No English or Chinese words, no target word, no watermark, generous margins. A question mark is an intentional symbol, not a label.
Primary request: The meaning is a question about a PERSON'S IDENTITY, not choosing an object. Three simple large human head-and-shoulder silhouettes (one taller adult, one shorter child, one adult with tied hair), muted blue-gray. The central person's blank face contains one huge dark question mark. No other objects, no arrows, no location, no clock. Make the human silhouettes unmistakable at small size.
rationale: Human identities with a question mark on a blank face; distinguishes person from thing/place/time.

Primary request: Show a question asking for a REASON, a cause-and-effect puzzle. A ten-year-old Chinese child looks puzzled at a puddle of spilled water on a tabletop; a tipped water bottle beside it is the visible CAUSE. The child raises one palm and looks from puddle toward the tipped bottle. One very large question mark sits between the tipped bottle and the resulting puddle, with a simple curved arrow joining bottle to puddle. Cause and effect dominate, not the child's identity or any choice among items. Only bottle, puddle, child and question mark on white. No broken glass, words, map, clock, multiple choices.
rationale: Tipped bottle causes a puddle; question mark and cause→effect arrow focus on the reason.

Primary request: PAST ABILITY through reminiscence. One cheerful elderly Chinese man, gray hair, gray moustache, distinctive ROUND BLUE GLASSES and red scarf, chest-up at lower left. A HUGE cloud-shaped memory bubble above him occupies 70 percent of the square. Inside that bubble, the SAME PERSON aged seven, black hair, identical round blue glasses and red scarf, successfully RIDES A TWO-WHEELED GREEN BICYCLE, both feet on pedals, smiling confidently. A bold GREEN TICK beside the childhood action. The memory bubble has a very light warm sepia tint and two small thought dots leading to the elderly man, making this a remembered past, not a current ability or a child standing beside a grandparent. Full bicycle and wheels readable at 80px; no scenery or writing.
rationale: Older character remembers the same younger self cycling successfully; memory bubble plus green tick.

Speech bubbles say hello in French, Spanish and Japanese; no English or Chinese greetings, target word or translation.
A recognisable blue information symbol and a facts display with distance, time and weather. Supports the abstract idea of useful facts.
A selected subject (space, among animals/sport) is repeated in both speakers’ bubbles: the thing their conversation is about.

Primary request: A PAIRED-CONTRAST flashcard with two equal large panels side by side, pure white background and rounded corners. Both panels show the SAME ten-year-old Chinese girl, ponytail and teal T-shirt. LEFT: healthy comfortable girl smiles and daydreams about an optional bright toy robot; a large robot in a thought bubble with a red HEART shows desire. RIGHT: girl is hot and visibly THIRSTY with sweat drops and dry mouth, holds an EMPTY water bottle and reaches for a glass of water; a large EXCLAMATION mark shows urgent necessity. A thick RED rounded rectangular frame highlights ONLY THE LEFT PANEL, the desire for a toy. Right panel has a light gray frame. No food, money, words or labels. Large faces and large symbols, simple flat drawing, readable at 80px overall.
rationale: Optional desire for a toy is highlighted; essential water is shown beside it for contrast.

prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Use the attached flashcard as the edit target. Create the matching NEED card from the paired WANT card. Preserve EXACTLY both illustrations, the same girl, all colors, both facial expressions, robot thought bubble with heart, thirsty girl with empty bottle and full glass, exclamation mark, panel positions, white background and square proportions. Change ONLY the two frame colors: the LEFT panel frame becomes light gray; the RIGHT panel frame becomes thick RED. The RIGHT panel showing an essential need for water is now highlighted, while the optional desire for a toy stays unhighlighted. Do not add any text, word, translation or symbol. Do not swap or redraw the panels.
rationale: Essential water for a thirsty child is highlighted; optional toy desire remains beside it.
